pitches.name: Moraine and Snowfield
pitches.beta: Easy snow. Kick steps with your crampons and keep the axe in your uphill hand. The rope is for the crevasses ahead: your axe is your protection.

pitches.name: Sun Cups
pitches.beta: Bumpy, sun-cupped snow. In the afternoon it turns to slush: climb early.

pitches.name: The Crevasse Field
pitches.beta: Blue ice and crevasses. Cross the snow bridges one at a time while your partner holds the rope tight.

cruxes.name: Crevasse bridge
cruxes.read: Spread your weight. Plant the axe beyond the bridge before you step onto it.

pitches.name: The Bergschrund
pitches.beta: The gap where the glacier pulls away from the mountain. Step across it, then scramble the rock to the ridge.

cruxes.name: The bergschrund
cruxes.read: Axe in high on the far lip first, then step across: don't jump.
